subject.title: Run indicator color collides with the error color

question: Which existing palette token should consistently represent active running work across Control UI session surfaces: `--accent-2` or `--info`?
rationale: Both candidates are technically small centralized changes, but assigning the durable semantic meaning of an active-run state is a product and brand-vocabulary choice.

options.title: Use `--accent-2` for running
options.body: Use the existing teal secondary-brand token for shared run indicators so active work is clearly separate from failures.

options.title: Use `--info` for running
options.body: Use the existing blue informational token if maintainers prefer conventional progress/status semantics.

options.title: Keep the accent treatment
options.body: Retain the current red run treatment if motion and shape are considered sufficient differentiation from errors.

recommendation.title: Use `--accent-2` for running
recommendation.body: Use the existing teal secondary-brand token for shared run indicators so active work is clearly separate from failures.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent merged indicator-placement work and supplied the detailed cross-surface analysis; the final product decision still requires maintainer intent.
